candidates.title: [RFC]: UltraQuant: the scale constant c = 0.156 is MSE-optimal before the UE8M0 snap, not after; c ≈ 0.2 cuts KV-quantization KL by 40–56% at no cost
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  `ultraquant_4bit` picks each group's UE8M0 scale as  ``` s_raw = c * absmax(group)          # c = 0.156 (DEFAULT_CONSTANT_C, vllm/v1/attention/ops/ultraquant/format.py) s     = 2^round(log2(s_raw))       # UE8M0 snap ```  The constant is documented as "MSE-optimal; `s_raw = c * absmax`, then UE8M0-snapped".
